_comment: COVERAGE-REINFORCE consumption of discover principal fixture_needs and deferral-keyed skip-deepen. Playbook phases 1, 2, 4. Verifier: coverage_verify.py --mode reinforce --strict-principal. Upstream: docs/discover-principal-contract.json, docs/coverage-principal-contract.json, docs/coverage-reinforce-topology-contract.json.

fixture_merge_scan.discover_filter: fixture_needs[] where derivation == ref_principal_provision OR linked_obligation_ids non-empty
fixture_merge_scan.coverage_match: linked_check_ids[] on fixture → pass-1 setup primary checks (environment_setup section or coverage_thread environment_setup)

fixture_merge_rules.action: Append checks[].linker_trace_lines (>) with > Discover: prefix naming kind, fixture id, sanitized notes, linked_obligation_ids; expand human operator_lines from docs/coverage-operator-hints.json fixture_kinds into detail_lines when missing
fixture_merge_rules.setup_depth_token: When setup_depth beyond classified_only, include depth token in linker_trace_lines (same hygiene as topology artifact merge)
fixture_merge_rules.forbidden: New executable top-level - scenario lines for provision rows; secrets in durable JSON; > Discover: or > Discovery: in detail_lines or smart_checklist_markdown

deferral_skip_rules.action: Skip-deepen — no new executable - lines on deferral-keyed out_of_epic checks; preserve verification_role out_of_epic, ! markers, keyed obligation_ids
deferral_skip_rules.optional_detail_line: linker_trace_lines only: > Discovery: deferral_obligation_keyed; no reinforce executable lines.
deferral_skip_rules.forbidden: Reopen deferral-keyed checks as new primary executable scenarios

emit_fields.sources.reinforce_principal_loaded: boolean when discover.sources.principal_loaded or provision fixtures merged

forbidden: New primary checks[] ids for provision or deferral rows
Executable - lines on deferral-keyed out_of_epic checks
Dropping pass-1 principal_provenance or keyed deferrals
Weakening pass-1 strict-topology or strict-principal bindings

strict_reinforce_principal_verifier.skip_when_no_principal: discover has no sources.principal_loaded and ref has no provision obligations and no deferral obligations
rules: when ref has provision obligations and discover has ref_principal_provision fixtures: sources.reinforce_principal_loaded true
each linked setup check linker_trace_lines mention fixture kind or id or linked_obligation_ids; detail_lines have >=1 operator-allowed prefix
validation_log contains reinforce-2-fixture-provision or reinforce-1-principal when provision fixtures merged
when discover validation_log has phaseE_skipped_deferral_keyed: deferral checks remain out_of_epic/deferral_only; scenario_line retains !

TEST-PRECON.use: pc-setup cluster steps and session placeholders (Round 2 step 6); see docs/precon-principal-contract.json
